Populate the failure reason on AwsS3V3Adapter exceptions

AwsS3V3Adapter passed an empty $reason for read, delete, deleteDirectory,
setVisibility and metadata failures, putting the underlying AwsException
only in $previous. write() in the same adapter already passes
$exception->getMessage(), as do the Local, GoogleCloudStorage and
AzureBlobStorage adapters, so reason() was inconsistent across operations
within a single adapter.

This matters beyond diagnostics: MountManager forwards $exception->reason()
when re-throwing, and UnableToProvideChecksum is constructed from it, so an
empty reason propagates as an empty reason.
